syllabus_text: Introduction to the engineering of computer applications emphasizing modern software engineering principles: program design, decomposition, encapsulation, abstraction, software testing, and Python programming.
Abstraction and software engineering principles of data abstraction and modularity. Covers recursion, algorithmic analysis, stacks, queues, sets, maps, trees, graphs, and C++ programming.

Discrete mathematics, computability theory, and complexity theory. Topics include formal proof writing, logic, set theory, binary relations, graph theory, induction, finite automata, regular expressions, Turing machines, and P versus NP.

Introduction to computer systems exploring how systems execute programs and manipulate data from the C programming language down to the microprocessor, including data representation, machine-level code, and memory management.

course_title: Introduction to Probability for Computer Scientists
syllabus_text: Combinatorics, random variables, conditional probability, independence, probability distributions, expectation, point estimation, statistics, and applications in machine learning and algorithmic analysis.
Constructing interactive web applications covering HTML, CSS, DOM, modern JavaScript frameworks, server-side JavaScript, SQL databases, and web application architectures.

Design and implementation of database and data-intensive systems: data modeling, SQL, schema design, query processing and optimization, transactions, concurrency control, distributed databases, and data warehousing for analytics.
Principles of cybersecurity and network security: attack techniques, defense mechanisms, operating system security, web and database application security, malware defense, and data privacy.
Worst and average-case analysis, recurrences, sorting, searching, binary search trees, heaps, hash tables, divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, and graph algorithms.

Statistical pattern recognition, linear and non-linear regression, generalized linear models, support vector machines, deep learning, feature engineering, clustering, PCA, reinforcement learning, and Python with NumPy.

Foundations of deep learning: neural networks, convolutional networks, RNNs, LSTMs, optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and applications in computer vision and natural language processing using Python.

course_title: Natural Language Processing with Deep Learning
syllabus_text: Natural language processing and deep learning methods: word embeddings, RNNs, LSTMs, attention mechanisms, Transformers, and training neural NLP models in Python and PyTorch.

Large-scale data mining and machine learning using MapReduce and Apache Spark in Python and Java. Topics include clustering, dimensionality reduction, recommendation systems, link analysis, and data streams.
